engineering_gates.explanation: Conservative acceptance-driver guards only, not universal chemical or resource-domain thresholds; epsilon*kappa <= approximately 2.3e-10. Small/nonfinite final-operator gap blocks comparable-root acceptance, with no changed occupations, regularization or tolerance.

threshold_basis: T04: same pinned raw engine, frozen ordinary stopping; T05: same exact D and raw arrays with independently contracted algebra; T06: frozen density stopping 2e-8 plus different Pulay endpoint allowance. Engineering candidate values frozen before first molecular execution; never relaxed after observations. P12/P13 unchanged from earlier contract.
state_selection: Same byte-identified D0, global closed-shell Aufbau 2/0. Compare density/occupied subspace and final recomputed non-DIIS operator; no equality claim for trajectories or MO signs. Different endpoints: ROOT_NOT_COMPARABLE, no research comparison.
resource_scope: Exact tested geometry/profile/dependency/rules/acceptance-bundle identity only; combined-process cgroup peak does not isolate per-mode peak or justify a general nAO model. No arbitrary-user Compute opening.
interpretation_candidate: Specified fixed-geometry conditional fixed-point functional response Eordinary-Econditional; not bond energy, experimental measurement, CT/POL decomposition, other-method equivalence or a proven variational minimum.
